background_origin.full_description:
## Abandoned Orphan

You grew up in alleys, ruins, kitchens, docks, roadside shrines, or abandoned courtyards. No one gave you a place. You survived by noticing danger early, hiding what mattered, and taking what you needed before someone stronger took it first.

### Ability Scores

Choose one:

- Increase one of the following ability scores by 2: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma.
- Increase two of the following ability scores by 1 each: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma.

### Skill Proficiencies

You gain proficiency in Deception and Sleight of Hand.

### Tool, Language, or Trade Proficiencies

You gain proficiency with thieves' tools and one language of your choice.

### Background Sphere and Talent

Choose one:

- **Scoundrel Sphere.** You gain the Scoundrel sphere and the **Grifter’s Hands** (`GRIFTER’S HANDS`) talent.
- **Scoundrel Sphere.** You gain the Scoundrel sphere and the **Hidden Tool Cache** (`HIDDEN TOOL CACHE`) talent.
- **Equipment Sphere.** You gain the Equipment sphere and the **Hidden Plates** talent.

### Starting Equipment

You begin with worn common clothes, a small knife, thieves' tools, a bedroll, a hidden pouch, three days of poor rations, and one keepsake from the life you lost or never had.

### Origin Insight Options

Suggested Origin Insights include:

- Street-Hardened
- Hunger Memory
- No One Saves You
- Quick Hands

### Social Hook

You know how people treat the powerless. Other outcasts may recognize you as one of their own, but officials, guards, and respectable families rarely assume the best of you.

sphere_automatic_components.full_description:
#### DIRTY TRICK
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Natural reach
Cost: None
Attempt an underhanded maneuver against one creature you can physically hinder.
Describe the method: throw grit into its eyes, knot a sleeve, stamp on a foot, box its ears, loosen a belt, hook a leg, slap a talisman across its vision, overturn a stool beneath it, or use another plausible tactic.
Make a Scoundrel Check against the target.
Success: Choose one appropriate result:
Eyes Spoiled. The target has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn.
Ears Ringing. The target has the Deafened condition until the start of your next turn.
Tangled Footwork. Halve the target’s Speed until the start of your next turn.
Low Sweep. The target has the Prone condition.
Jammed Guard. The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Open the Guard. Apply Exploited Opening.
The GM may approve a comparable effect when the description, anatomy, and surroundings support it. A base Dirty Trick should not inflict a stronger condition than those listed above.
A creature without the relevant anatomy or vulnerability is immune to an inappropriate effect.
If a talent extends a physical Dirty Trick beyond the start of your next turn, the target or an adjacent creature can normally take the Utilize action to end that physical hindrance early.

#### Rider Package
You cultivate partnership through the saddle, harness, rein, knee, breath, and shared momentum.
Gain Skillful Riding.
##### Skillful Riding
While you ride a willing mount, when the mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage:
it takes no damage on a success;
it takes half damage on a failure.

sphere_automatic_components.full_description:
#### STEAL
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Natural reach
Cost: None
Choose one accessible object. Attempt to take it, reposition it, or plant one Tiny object in an accessible location.
##### Aware Target
Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature.
##### Unaware Target
Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against the target’s Passive Perception.
##### Difficult Object
Make your check with Disadvantage if the object is securely fastened, worn tightly, held in two hands, or similarly difficult to remove.
##### Success
Choose one appropriate result:
take the object into a free hand;
cause the object to fall into an unoccupied space within your reach;
reposition the object to another accessible location on the same target;
plant one Tiny object in an accessible location on the target.
You may use Steal to remove an object from a creature’s hand as a local Scoundrel disarm rule.
Steal does not automatically activate, identify, attune to, or safely handle the object.

sphere_automatic_components.one_line_description: #### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training.
sphere_automatic_components.full_description:
#### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training.
Gain Tame.
##### Tame
Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat.
Requirements:
find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature;
spend 8 hours training one creature;
make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is:
10 + the creature’s Challenge Rating
Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame.
Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle.
You may train only one creature at a time.
##### Tamer Capacity
You may maintain:
a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus;
a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8.
If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit.
##### Commands
Tame Creatures follow your commands to the best of their ability.
Giving ordinary commands requires no Action unless a talent says otherwise.
Without a command, a Tame Creature acts according to its nature, training, and circumstances.
##### Contested Control
When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make:
Charisma check
opposed by your:
Wisdom (Animal Handling) check
Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails.
Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally.
##### Awakening
A beast that becomes sapient is no longer an ordinary Tame Creature.
Its future relationship should be resolved through:
consent;
narrative agreement;
a Beast Companion bond;
Beast-sphere cultivation;
Spirit practices;
or another appropriate feature. Combat Rule Reminders
